newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan September offshore banking unit assets rise.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan September offshore banking unit assets rise.

text.p: The combined assets of Taiwan's 63 offshore banking units (OBU) rose three percent to US$35.2 billion at the end of September from a year earlier, the central bank said in a statement on Thursday.
About 78 percent of the assets, held by 35 local banks and 28 foreign banks, came from Asia and the rest from Europe and America, the statement said.
The bank had recently approved applications from two foreign banks and two local banks to set up OBUs.
Taiwan's OBUs reported a monthly foreign exchange turnover of $4.99 billion, the statement said.
Out of the derivatives operated by the OBUs, financial futures accounted for $140 million, options took $213 million and interest rate swaps accounted for $66 million, it said.
